description: Raw herring, Clupea harengus and relatives; a whole herring sold with its roe inside belongs here.

display_name: Prawns or shrimp, species not named
description: Prawns or shrimp whose pack does not say which species.
Prawn sold under the trade name banana prawn (a name that may cover several species).
Prawn sold under the trade name king prawn (a name that may cover several species).
A mix of seafood sold as one product, where no single seafood makes up half or more of the weight.
Smoked belly flaps of dogfish, known by the German name Schillerlocke.
Whole or cut seafood preserved by salting and fermenting and eaten as the seafood itself; a paste or sauce is in Pantry Staples.
Roe of Acipenser gueldenstaedtii or A. persicus (osetra sturgeon), sold as grain caviar; Siberian and hybrid sturgeon caviars are listed separately.
Pâté, terrine or galantine of fish sold as a loaf or slice to be cut; a spread or dip in a jar or tub is in Pantry Staples.
Cod flesh packed in a sealed tin or jar; tinned cod liver is listed separately.
Raw freshwater eel of the genus Anguilla, sold whole or as fillets.
Raw catfish of the Ictaluridae and Clariidae, sold whole or as fillets; pangasius is sold separately.
Black tiger prawn Penaeus monodon sold under the name tiger; a pack saying only king prawn is King prawn.
Shark fin dried for rehydrating and cooking.
Sprats Sprattus sprattus smoked whole and sold chilled; tinned smoked sprats are in Tinned & jarred fish.
Mackerel (Scomber) fillets or pieces packed in a sealed tin or jar; jack and horse mackerel are listed separately.
Herring fillets or pieces packed in a sealed tin, smoked or not; jarred marinated herring is Marinated herring.
Milkfish Chanos chanos smoked whole or butterflied, sold chilled or frozen; tinned smoked milkfish is in Tinned & jarred fish.
Cuttlefish (Sepia) dried whole, in pieces or shredded; dried squid is Dried squid.
Fish cooked, shredded and dry-fried with light seasoning into a fine dry floss; a blend led by seaweed, sesame or flour is a topping in Pantry Staples.
Cod liver cooked and packed in its own oil in a sealed tin; cod flesh is Tinned cod, cod liver oil is in Health, Medical & Mobility.
Tuna loin salted and air-dried, sold whole or sliced; protected regional makes such as Mojama de Barbate are included.
Sturgeon flesh (Acipenseridae) packed in a sealed tin; its roe is Sturgeon caviar.
Roe of farmed sturgeon crosses (Huso dauricus x Acipenser schrenckii, Huso huso x A. ruthenus and others), sold as grain caviar.
Jack or horse mackerel (Trachurus) packed in a sealed tin; Scomber mackerel is Tinned mackerel.
Raw pufferfish (Takifugu and relatives), sold whole or dressed with toxic organs removed, or as sashimi cuts; live fish are not included.
Raw trout Salmo trutta, sea-run (sea trout, sewin) or river-resident (brown trout), sold whole or as fillets; rainbow trout is Rainbow trout.
Raw whitefish of the genus Coregonus (vendace, pollan, lake whitefish), sold whole or as fillets; tinned whitefish is Tinned whitefish.
Juvenile small fish (anchovy, sardine, sprat, herring or galaxiid fry) sold whole, raw or plain boiled and uncoated; semi-dried fry is in Salted, dried & cured.
Rockfish (Sebastes) salted and dried or half-dried, sold whole to grill or steam; raw rockfish is Rockfish.
Small sea bream fillets salted, then marinated in vinegar and sold chilled in a tub or tray; the Wakasa Obama kodai version is included.
Shad (Alosa) salted and smoked, cold or hot, sold whole or as fillets; tinned smoked shad is in Tinned & jarred fish.
Raw anchovy of the genus Engraulis, sold whole, chilled or frozen; fry sold as whitebait is Whitebait, marinated is Marinated anchovies, tinned is Tinned anchovies.
Raw cuttlefish of the genus Sepia, sold whole or cleaned, chilled or frozen; dried cuttlefish is Dried cuttlefish, squid is Squid.
